quality.review_scope: Independent scoped source audit accepted all seven main and eight eligible SI pages, with source-supported preparation, measured specimens, controls and statistical models kept distinct. No formal complete-paper Reader or atomistic training eligibility is claimed.
missing_fields: The supplied main article (7 pages) and matched SI (8 pages) were read as text and visually inspected. Cited external recipes were not accessed.
This source reports patterning of pre-existing CdSe/CdS QDs; it does not supply a complete nanocrystal growth recipe.
Physical batch identity across figures is not established by a shared size or preparation family. Measurements, pre-lift specimens and statistical models retain separate contexts.
No raw image/curve digitization or measured atomic coordinate reconstruction is claimed.

LB subphase, spreading solvent/charge, QD concentration, surface pressure, compression and withdrawal speeds are unreported. Lithography dose/developer, resist dilution and quantitative plasma settings are unreported.
Image-specific SEM instrument overlays do not define a universal setting for every image. No raw spectra or full acquisition settings supplied.
